comment: Bootstrap-only pins. Upstream commit/tag come from compat/upstream.lock.json, emsdk/OpenH264 pins from tools/codecs/openh264/build.lock.json, libFLAC/Wasm pins from tools/codecs/flac/inputs.json and reference binary pins from the tracked records reference.pins names; none is repeated here.

reference.comment: pins: the tracked record whose platforms.<host> entry (artifacts, platform, arch, compiler; commit, tag and flags at its top level) is that host's pinned build. No tool writes it; tests resolve the same pins through tests/helpers/reference-identity.ts. linkInputs: per pinned ffmpeg hash, the SHA-256 of `shasum -a 256` lines (sorted by path) of every lib*/lib*.a and fftools/**/*.o, which tells a nondeterministic link apart from a different compiler.

flacInvestigation.comment: Byte-identical copies of the untracked generators that produced the original .build/flac-investigation evidence. They are staged at their original paths so recorded generatorSha256/adapterSha256 values stay true. outputs: content pins per pinned reference ffmpeg hash; every ffmpeg in compat/reference-pins.json must have one, and each is recorded only from a run of that platform's reference ('source').

5e43da9ad1ee070f7e27c171b2ed2a311100f3d4.source: linux-x64: worker-reference-and-codec artifact of the reference job (139088434864) of GitHub Actions run 45580321573 (.github/workflows/ci.yml at ddaa9dc1b758), a GitHub-hosted x86_64 runner in the pinned image; that job's reference equals the linux-x64 pin, all six pinned libraries included
